combos_and_parlays#u4.detail: Verified the combos record had no weather input (environment was GAP). Added new input nfl.combo_shared_weather_leg_coupling (calm/moderate/severe weather regime conditioning the joint draw; leg pairs total x QB yards, total x kicker/long FG, QB x receiver yards, total x rusher, kicker x team total), stage s8 using it with nfl.weather_pit, nfl.weather_total_response and nfl.kicker, a threshold interaction, a weather required_data entry, and set environment to COVERED. Leg-pair elasticities themselves remain an empirical fit.

combos_and_parlays#u5.detail: Confirmed no cross-archetype output contract existed. Added new input nfl.sibling_leg_marginal_interface to combos_and_parlays: interface v1 naming producer archetypes (spread, game/team total, QB yards, receiving, rushing, TD scorer, half/quarter totals), per-leg P(yes) under each leg's settlement rule, and a shared-seed 20,000-draw matrix (home/away points, regulation points, OT flag, plays, QB/key-player active flags, weather bin, leg stat) with consistency checks; stage s1 now references it.

game_events#u1.detail: Verified online (NBC/PFT 2025 league-meeting reports, PFT 2025 OT explainer): from 2025 regular-season OT gives both teams a possession, stays 10 minutes, then sudden death, ties possible; the first team can still win by scoring on a drive using the full period. Patched nfl.ot_model (mechanism, measurement) and nfl.ot_ending_hazard (mechanism, measurement) in input_patches/NFL_a.json with rule eras 2017-2024 / 2025+ and the final OT margin lattice {1..8} replacing 0/3/6; rewrote game_events stage g2 and added an OT rule-era edge case.

off_field_events#u3.detail: Verified series_assignment.json: KXNFLOWNERSTAKE and KXNFLSTADIUM were re-filed to OUT_OF_SCOPE (franchise_ownership_business, team_facilities), so only the celebrity series (KXNFLHKANE, KXNFLCOMPETE) and venue retention (KXNFLGAMELOCATION) still lacked a class. Patched nfl.offfield_base_rate (mechanism, rationale, measurement, sources, raw_data) with per-series reference classes, incl. a cross-sport-athlete signing/snap class with Beta(0.5,0.5) prior and an international-game retention class, and explicit exclusion of the two re-filed series; stage o6 now uses it.

season_awards#u7.detail: Verified online (AP/WBUR/SI reports, Feb 2026; CBS/PFT on the 2022 change): AP MVP since 2022 is a 50-voter top-5 ballot scored 10-5-3-2-1 (2025 MVP Stafford 366 pts/24 firsts vs Maye 361/23); other AP awards and Coach of the Year use a top-3 ballot scored 5-3-1. Patched nfl.vote_outcome_model (rank-ordered logit, simulated 50 ballots, pre/post-2022 regimes) and nfl.teammate_vote_split_penalty (placement-specific penalty, regime split); rewrote stage s6 (removed the plurality claim and the SOURCE_UNVERIFIED panel assumption) and recorded ballot format per award.

team_total#u6.detail: Verified current catalog: nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean no longer mentions KXNFLBOTH (already fixed by a later pass; review 'why' text updated). nfl.paired_score_covariance_own still described the both-teams-35 contract; patched its mechanism, rationale and measurement to output the joint home/away pmf from which team_total reads the conditional single-team pmf, game_total (which already stages KXNFLBOTH on it) reads P(both>=N), and slate extremes read total tails. Updated both 'why' texts in team_total.

unreg:combine_testing_results#u6.detail: Verified on the Kalshi events API (2026-11-08): KXNFLCOMBINE has VERT26, BROAD26, BENCH26 and 4026 events (settlement sources ESPN, NFL Network); vertical/bench market rules are no longer retrievable, recorded as an edge case. Added new inputs nfl.combine_bench_press_pool_and_prior (lineman pool, arm length, opt-outs) and nfl.combine_vertical_jump_prior (correlated with broad-jump prior), stage s6 and a joint-distribution interaction; patched nfl.combine_drill_extreme_history to fit vertical and bench yearly maxima.

unreg:fantasy_points_markets#u2.detail: Read the full live KXNFLFFPTS rules via the Kalshi API: Sleeper kicker scoring FG 0-39 +3, 40-49 +4, 50-59 +5, 60+ +6, XP +1, misses -1, and a D/ST table (events plus points-allowed tiers +10..-4); live D/ST markets exist for most teams. Corrected stage s5 (it claimed weights were not shown), added new inputs nfl.fantasy_kicker_points_chain and nfl.fantasy_dst_points_chain, stage s11 and two interactions (D/ST piecewise points-allowed, kicker red-zone conditional).

unreg:slate_extremes#u2.detail: Verified the live KXNFLGAMESPECIALS-27 market list on the Kalshi API: passing yds 475/500/525, pass TD 6+, receiving yds 250-300, receptions 15/17/20 (15,17 settled YES), non-passing TD 4+, sacks 4-6, tackles 20+, def INT 2/3 (settled YES), D/ST TD 2+, 100rush+100rec, and quarter rungs 250 pass/150 rush/150 rec (OT excluded per rules). Added new inputs nfl.player_single_game_stat_extreme_family and nfl.player_single_quarter_stat_extreme, stages s7/s8, a rules quote, an interaction and a nonlinearity.

unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials#u.detail: Verified against series_assignment.json (15 series) and the current record: every family already has its own chain (s2 FG, s3 sacks/INT hazard, s4 yards, s6 league ties and 60+ FGs, s7 score-path functionals, s8 coach decisions/rare play calls). Added an explicit series-to-family-to-stage routing to contract.variants_and_edge_cases. No archetype-key split was made (series assignment is outside this resolver's scope); the substantive defect, missing distinct chains, does not exist.
